name: TradingAgents
description: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
one_liner: A framework where a team of AI 'analyst' bots debate stock picks and hand off a buy/sell decision, like a mini trading desk.
buyer: A retail algorithmic trader or small quant hobbyist who wants a research-and-debate process behind their trades instead of gut-feel picks.
business_use_cases: A retail trader runs it nightly on a personal watchlist to get a written research memo before the market opens.
A fintech newsletter writer uses its multi-agent debate output as the raw material for a daily 'bull vs bear' column.
A small quant shop backtests its decision logic against historical data to validate a signal before risking real capital.

money_ideas.idea: Package daily AI-generated trade theses as a paid newsletter or Discord subscription for retail traders.
Offer a hosted version with brokerage integration, charging for compute and data access.

steal_this: Run it this weekend against a 10-stock watchlist, backtest the last 6 months, and publish the results as a free Substack post to build an audience before selling a paid tier.
